what: A background-color mask (canvas) covers the video and photos, and each cursor trail makes five smoke blobs punch holes so what is below shows through — each trail spreads 1→1.7x over 800ms while fading, so the mask fills back in (hole diameter 220px · follow .3 · a trail every 4px · on 100ms). When left alone, every 10s it sweeps once by itself across the panel from 25%→75% in 1s cubic in-out (no auto-sweep on phone or touch)

options.auto: Auto-sweep interval (seconds), default 10 — 0 means no sweep
options.on: If state, it doesn’t sweep right away even when attached, it waits for the fx:play event (after the first heading appears)
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Curtain canvas — created if absent. The user places the video or photo below inside the panel (z-index 1 or lower)

use: …
note: Place text above the overlay (z-index 3 or higher). On touch, pressing and dragging leaves a trace while the page still scrolls vertically (touch-action: pan-y). With reduced motion, the overlay is not drawn and the video shows as is.
